channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Winner Finally Called in Mississippi Senate Race
item.description: A building in Brooklyn collapses, leaving people trapped under rubble. CNN projects Democrat Scott Colom will defeat incumbent Cindy Hyde-Smith in deep-red Mississippi. Video shows a soldier reprimanding Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and a group of his advisers at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Russia has announced the sudden death of its ambassador to the US. A driver is facing murder and DUI charges for a fatal crash in North Hollywood. Plus, investigators explain how they discovered a missing baby buried alive. Learn more about your ad choices.
